notes: Small old enamel trilingual plate (Georgian in Mtavruli capitals, Armenian, Russian) on a corner house in Akhalkalaki, far from the camera. The abbreviations are tiny: small ქ. after the Georgian, փ. after the Armenian and ул. before the Russian; the ул. is barely legible. Query uses the Russian line because it is the only script the reader handles here. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.
